verdict.rationale: Vanta's marketing says it lets you 'track progress all in one place' with 'continuous, complete visibility' across frameworks, and that it flags gaps through automated tests. The API can also list tests and pull controls and evidence filtered by framework. Together these imply a progress view, but no evidence describes a per-framework readiness screen that breaks down passing controls, open gaps, and remaining work. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented per-framework readiness percentage, a breakdown of passing versus failing controls and remaining work in one view, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the percentage is accurate.
